fail_closed_rehearsal.interpretation: Expected. Missing database/tooling did not become PASS; the sole PASS was a database-independent static check.

real_postgresql_integration.reason: The artifact-generation environment does not provide psql, pgbench, pg_amcheck, pg_verifybackup, psycopg, Docker/Podman, or a PostgreSQL test instance.

notes: Framework PASS means the harness/gates/parsers/reporting were self-tested; it is not database release qualification for any application.
Expert pre-release gates deliberately require project-bound evidence and fail when those bindings are absent.
Real qualification must run in an isolated production-representative PostgreSQL environment.
